items.note: N1 gives the gate types, the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoration of scratch wires, but never states h=100, the triple indexing of the banks, the neighbour rules or the central/side coefficients (|S cap T| mod 2, (|S cap T|-1)/2). The route (cancel old scratch, net change independent of it, coefficients cancel, forward-inverse-forward gives (x,y)->(-y,x)) matches lines 741-764, but the coefficient cancellation, the essential step, is only alluded to.

N2 states the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, the edge operator D_v D_u^{-1} and that only endpoint frames matter; the invariant-plus-commutation argument is the paper's proof (804-817).

Nested nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3}, the only decreasing edges (centre 3->4, loss h) and L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539 are stated, but the budget sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich are not (N3 only says 'below W m'). The derivation omits the telescoping count of source and sink dimensions (1066-1071) and the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines that makes the side-wire inclusions possible (863-870, 1048-1055).

The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m, XOR gates, projections P_U and -P_{U_a}, and s_b<W_b m with deficit N-2L_b (equivalent to s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b) are all stated. The proof's step that the N source edges are exceptions of rank one with zero dimension change (1162-1166) is missing, and that step is what turns -2N into -N.

Kernels aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, telescoping to C^{tensor m} and the Z-correction of the X_a->Y_a pair follow 1231-1315. The plan gives only s_c<W_c m, not s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and calls the frames the diagonal phases i^{wt(P_U x)} rather than their Hadamard conjugates C_U.

L/N<1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, deficits >20*2^{-50} and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} are stated in infer steps. The eta values are not given, nor are log m<20 and the inequality m^{1-2^{-50}} > m(1-20*2^{-50}) > m(1-eta) (1331-1338) that justify the exponent, so I give no derivation credit.

Split/map/merge, digit moves, cyclic row splitting and controlled shifts and unit scalings are stated with the paper's proofs (split at Q-a and re-merge; increasing pieces for units). T2 omits the hypotheses that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time and that the coefficients have denominators (and, for units, numerators) prime to q (557-568).

A=E1 Pi E2 with lower-triangular factors and a partial permutation with a ones, the topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, and the sequence of triangular transforms with one interchange per pivot all match 1375-1447.

The plan has the row split into W role streams of volume V/W, edge shears by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three updates giving the interchange, s calls, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) => F_k=O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule at O(V) per node. The base case F_0=O(1) is left implicit.
High digits supply a row field of range at least W^k with padding to a multiple of W^k, the base-m pieces form a geometric sum O(V e^tau), and the binary chunks are padded to [q^e], as in 1649-1734.

Conjugation by P_M, row additions on whole slots, s_c forward children on e/m axes, inverse children through Z wrappers, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D follow 1848-1940. L1's phrase 's_c residual-basis slots' is loose (there are m slots), but L1.2 states the count correctly.

The plan follows the proof at 2013-2231: eight rotations as swap/shift/unswap, the two three-cycles, the bad set with guard interval [10, 2^{K-1}-11] and fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K}, the bijection argument, the radix-sort repair, the top position by a two-bit XOR, and the cost O(V(L^tau+1)).

Node overhead, rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to W^{k_0}, and F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) are stated. The leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, K <= e^{c/beta} and the leaf contribution O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) are missing. Without that contribution the condition lambda' > max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)} (2421-2445) is not explained, and L2.3 claims the whole recurrence sums to O(e^lambda).

O(V d^{lambda'}), exact evaluation with p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits from A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E, Delta=o(p) from epsilon C_1<1, conversion to H_0, and a single truncation with error <sqrt2 2^{-p} all match 2450-2758. The weakness in the recurrence is charged to layer-recurrence.

Character cancellation by the shift t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, the layout L with prefix slots and at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges, the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]) and the error <sqrt2 l 2^{-p} all match the paper.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, centred-residue extraction using |h_j|<B_0/2, the negacyclic wrap and the cost O(rp log(rp)) follow 3233-3368.

Retaining the LB order, signed-packed products, the opposite transform, scaling by M=T/r, error 3delta+eta then M(3l+1)sqrt2 2^{-p}, and the commuting of pointwise products with the record permutation (H motivation) match 3202-3206 and 3414-3473. The normalization identity check is not spelled out.

P_s F_s = 2^{2 alpha^2} B_0 P_t F_t A with theta>p/alpha^4, ||N-I||<1/2, the left inverse, error p^2 and time O(t p^{3/2+delta} alpha), the tensor form with gamma, and axis exposure at O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) all match. The explicit definitions of P_s and P_t are not given.
The chirp identity Q F_t u = conj(a) . (a*(conj(a) . u))/T is proved by comparing coefficients, and R F^+ R = F^+ by dilation, giving (u*v)/S^2 and the conjugation for RF^+, exactly as in 3938-3987.

The fixed exponents, the sizes b, p, d, K, T, alpha, gamma, the prime intervals, the trial division in n^{o(1)}, T/2<S<T and the non-wrapping digit convolution are stated. eta=1/(4d) is never given, and the check alpha^4 theta_i > 3db >= p that turns the separation into the resampling hypothesis (4146-4150) is missing.

Phi: x -> prod x_i^{mu_i} with mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the isomorphism, the triangular prefix-controlled shifts updated from i=d down, and axis reversal by O(d^2) chunk swaps at O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) match. The explicit formula for b_i is described only in words.
x_d -> zeta y with zeta=e^{pi i/r}, well-definedness, the diagonal isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h = zeta^j, and the computed twist arrays with error 2*2^{-p} follow 4303-4392.

The source transform (A, chirp, B_0, 2^gamma) with exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugated opposite, the six-step algorithm and the roles of the two S scalings match 4456-4544. A's summary drops the second S in 2^{2b+4}S, but A8 has it right.

The plan has contraction and bilinear error propagation, chirp error 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, the opposite error (3E_s+2)h_p, the final error 448b 2^{-b+gamma} <= 448b 2^{-3b/4} < 1/2, rounding, and carries with the invariant. E_w=S(3E_s+2) and gamma <= b/4 are left implicit.

V=Tp, min g_i = g_2 = 2^{-181} = 2 kappa, log factors below p^kappa, O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) and the schoolbook cutoff are stated. The seven normalized costs and the margin formulas (g_2=epsilon c(1-tau) from the pK^{tau-1} row) are never listed, and the o(V) bounds for setup and exceptional streams (4913-4981) are missing.
R relies on 'nlogn-conjecture', but no step states what an eventual n lg n lower bound means or that the power saving refutes it.

errors.says: Both procedures are obtained 'from one fixed linear network that exchanges two banks of values'.
errors.paper: Two fixed networks are built: the bit network with rational labels for the interchange and the complex (Gaussian dyadic) network with binary labels for the layer, with different constants (643-651, 2235-2240).

errors.says: Method: edge differences are projections onto residuals, whose rank is the dimension change.
errors.paper: The N source edges of X_a are exceptions: their matrix is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one, while the dimension change is zero. This is why s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b rather than W_b m - 2N + 2L_b (1162-1166).

errors.says: The phase frames are i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}, and each edge's frame change is a product of translation kernels.
errors.paper: The frame is C_U = H^{tensor m} diag(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{tensor m}. Only after this Hadamard conjugation do the diagonal phase differences become translation kernels aI+bX_v (1193, 1254-1257).

errors.says: Apply the f-fold forward child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots.
errors.paper: A group has m slots. On each edge, one child acts on slot h for each residual basis vector (h <= rho_edge), and s_c is the total number of children over one network invocation (1878-1882, 1904-1906).

errors.says: With a=s/W<m^lambda, the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) sums to O(e^lambda).
errors.paper: Only the internal costs sum to O(e^lambda). The leaves contribute O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), which is why lambda' must exceed max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)} (2413-2445).
The second scale is 2^{2b+4} S (4521-4522, 4718-4720). A8 and A9 state it correctly.

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route: the scalar exchange network, frames, labels, the bit and complex interfaces, the chunk interchange and the simultaneous layer, then synthetic transforms and convolution, resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation, the CRT and twist, the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out in the label budget (no Wm-2N+2L, no L=Ich, no orthogonality of neighbouring triples), in the source-edge rank exception, in the layer recurrence's leaf term and in the unlisted cost table. None of these breaks the chain.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch wires is stated. h=100, the triple indexing a in T^3 of the banks, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear, so I choose the conservative verdict.
N2 has the common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the edge change D_v D_u^{-1}, so only endpoint frames matter.
Nested nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional F^{tensor 3}, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central wires from time 3 to 4 decreasing, each by h.
N4's method states that edge differences are residual projections whose rank is the dimension change. The exception of the N rank-one source edges is missing.
Neither sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L nor L=Ich is stated. N3 says only that the total change is below Wm, and N4.1's deficit N-2L_b implies s_b without deriving it from a budget.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m.
M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m on every role, with P_{U_a^perp} - (-P_{U_a}) = I_m for X_a, giving H<-H+D on every row.
A=E1 Pi E2 gives exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per shear, so a node makes s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W give F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits >20*2^{-50} gives F_k=O(e^tau). log m<20 is not stated.

central.summary: The plan carries the central chain from frames through labels, rank equals dimension change, the strict saving L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. Two links are weak: it never fixes the network's parameters (h=100, triple-indexed banks, N, m=h^3), and it never states the dimension budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, so s<Wm appears as a stated deficit and is not counted out.
